caption: The locked table shows six sample projects.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['bases-read-only']; p.pro.signOut(); p.settings = {locked: ['Bases Read Only/Projects.base'], rules: [], editable: [], kiosk: false}; await p.saveAndRefresh(true); await app.workspace.openLinkText('Bases Read Only/Projects.base#Projects', '', false); return 'ok'; })()
after: (async () => { document.querySelector('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .bases-toolbar-views-menu .text-icon-button')?.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100)); require('fs').writeFileSync('/tmp/brl-native-menu.json', JSON.stringify([...document.querySelectorAll('.menu, .popover')].map(el => el.outerHTML))); document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key:'Escape',bubbles:true})); return 'ok'; })()

caption: The weekly review has one locked embed and one editable embed.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['bases-read-only']; p.pro.signOut(); p.settings = {locked: ['Bases Read Only/Projects.base'], rules: [], editable: [], kiosk: false}; await p.saveAndRefresh(true); const leaf = app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('markdown').find(l => l.view.file?.path === 'Bases Read Only/Review.md'); await leaf.setViewState({type:'markdown', state:{file:'Bases Read Only/Review.md', mode:'preview'}}); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); require('fs').writeFileSync('/tmp/brl-embed.html', document.querySelector('.workspace-leaf.mod-active')?.outerHTML ?? 'no active leaf'); return 'ok'; })()

caption: The locked cards show the same sample projects.

caption: The Pro options use the demo sponsor reply.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['bases-read-only']; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('bases-read-only-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); p.settings = {locked:['Bases Read Only/Projects.base'], rules:['Archive/**.base'], editable:['done'], kiosk:false}; await p.saveAndRefresh(true); app.setting.open(); app.setting.openTabById('bases-read-only'); return 'ok'; })()
